result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make high-quality education freely accessible to every person—education that teaches not just facts, but critical thinking, empathy, and how to learn.

So many of the world’s biggest problems—poverty, inequality, conflict, misinformation—are rooted in lack of access to knowledge and the inability to understand perspectives different from our own. Giving people the tools to think clearly and care deeply would ripple outward into almost every area of life.
